evidence: Walked every graded criterion against the frozen golden source; found none it cannot plausibly satisfy. Gates: render, where a wrong password gives 401 at src/index.js:87 and the shell is index.html; constraints, where the Observer bootstrap returns all jobs and applications (index.js:178-191). Functional, 40 rows: job_open validates title, team, hiring_manager role and an integer from 1 to 50 (index.js:204-207), and the UI regex in board.js:72 turns 2.5 into NaN, which the server refuses. add_email_rules: the email regex and case-insensitive duplicate return details.field='candidate_email' (index.js:221-224), the fault is shown at the field and the name is kept (board.js:53), and UNIQUE(job_id,email) allows other jobs (db.js:38). move_one_stage: adjacent-only checking (index.js:253-254) and Move-to select controls (board.js:144-158, 226-232). arrive_bottom and reorder: bottom by default, and Up/Down use before_id (index.js:305, board.js:233-241). reject_reason/hired/reopen are at index.js:248-252. Undo restores rejected_from and reject_reason from before_json (index.js:301-302, 352). interview_full, reorder_free and undo_full: entering excludes cards already in Interview, and the undo returning-count check is at index.js:289-293 and 344-346. refused_put_back: the snapshot is restored and focus goes to the card select (board.js:191-198, 166-171). Manager rules are at index.js:257-263; observer, candidate and anonymous get 401/403 through auth() and checkMove role (index.js:73-81, 239). stale_refused: a version mismatch gives 409 with the last activity detail, e.g. 'Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied', which names the person (index.js:241-245). Bulk: one transaction ranked by stage*100000+position with a whole-set Interview count (index.js:283-294). Undo is single-use and latest-only (index.js:337-342). Activity: describe() lines for open, add, move, reject with reason, reopen, reorder and undo, newest first, with a job filter (index.js:189, 265-270, 353; app.js:45-85). notes: a 403 for another job's manager (index.js:369), and the Observer reads them through STAFF GET (index.js:363). Live: SSE 'changed' after every successful write triggers a keyed in-place refresh (index.js:48-53; app.js:133-157). Threads: the latest 30 by id DESC, reversed, plus earlier_count paging (index.js:384-391; seed thread_page_size 30; Noor APP-101 has 120 messages). Compose: Enter, Shift+Enter, pre-wrap, cleared and refocused (threads.js:183-201; styles.css:105). unread: per-user reads exclude your own messages. The seed gives Lena 2 of 3 read, with the last message from USR-REC3, so 1 unread (index.js:132-133; db.js:82-83). scrolled_up adds pending to the pill with no markRead (threads.js:145-159). seen: the boundary excludes the observer (index.js:143-150). Access: index.js:114-120. Drafts: localStorage keyed by user id and conversation (app.js:39-43; threads.js:112,124,182). Candidate: LABELS wording and a dedicated read model without notes, reason, rejected_from, position or activity (index.js:171-176). Staff detail gives a 403 to candidates (index.js:363), another application gives a 404 (index.js:127), and account linking is at index.js:225. restart: seedIfEmpty (db.js:61-62). Polish: in-place patching keeps the detail panel, note focus and draft (board.js:321-341, 98, 120). The earlier-place anchor is at threads.js:167-171. A failed send has fetch-catch status 0, keeps the text and shows an error (app.js:31; threads.js:194). Session resume: 401 calls sessionLost, then a per-user draft restore (app.js:34, 189-195). Visual Likert rows are plausible from the CSS and screenshots. Runtime support: scripted golden workspace.json shows 18/18 groups passing against hash-matched frozen bytes, including stale-with-name, bulk/undo, live board (806 ms), thread paging and place keeping (workspace.cjs:278-282), unread/seen, session resume, observer and restart. risk=true because no full configured judge run or Oracle score exists for any dimension. Also unscripted, so source-only: the polish hro_pol_failed_send abort path, Activity per-job completeness (the list shows 50 lines, then a 'Show more (N earlier)' button, app.js:46,79-80), invalid/0/51/2.5 job-open refusals, and the per-criterion Functional walk. Those claims are plausibility from source, not measurement.
